title: The Tag groups tab lists your own and public groups with three columns
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell and select the Tag groups tab. An active location is selected (the location name shown next to the bell; change it with your initials at the top right -> Change Location).
  3. Seed a tag group: on the Tag groups tab click New tag group, type a Name (e.g. "Service Team"), pick at least one Member (e.g. "Ashlee Thomas"), leave Public off (or turn it on for a public group), and Create. Include a public group and a personal group; and reach a state with no groups.
custom_steps:
1. Read which groups the list shows (your own + public at the location).
  2. Read the columns and the Members cell (with "+N" when there are more than fit).
  3. Read the Visibility cell values.
  4. View the tab with no groups to show.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Tag groups tab lists your own tag groups and every public tag group at the active location.
  • The list has columns Name, Members and Visibility; the Members cell shows member names with a "+N" count when there are more than fit; the Visibility cell reads "Personal" or "Public".
  • When there are no groups to show, the list reads "No tag groups."

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.
